tools.name: get_capabilities
tools.description: Returns the supported question types, the plain-text format reference and plan limits. Call this once before drafting a survey.

tools.name: parse_form
tools.description: Parses a survey written in the SurveysAI plain-text format and returns the title, form description, questions, errors and warnings. Creates nothing.

tools.name: validate_form
tools.description: Runs deterministic checks on a survey draft and returns issues with suggestions. Creates nothing.

tools.name: create_google_form
tools.description: Creates the survey as a Google Form in the signed-in user's own Google account and returns its link. Call only after the user has agreed to the title and questions.

tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Returns the signed-in user's stable pseudonymous id, name and email.

tools.name: get_account_status
tools.description: Returns the signed-in user's plan, the maximum number of questions per form, whether a Google account is linked and whether SurveysAI may create Google Forms in it (google_forms_access: granted, missing or unknown).

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_profile · Public sink: get_profile · Destructive: get_capabilities, parse_form.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_profile · Public sink: get_profile · Destructive: get_capabilities, parse_form

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
